carpet.rule.fakePlayerTpp.name: Fake Player Pearl Station TP
carpet.rule.fakePlayerTpp.desc: Use fake players to trigger pearl teleport stations, with station completion by internal or display name. /tpp requires Carpet TIS Addition.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNameSuggestions.de: Customize the fake player names suggested by the /player command, separated by ','
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinMode.name: Fake Player Skin Mode
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinMode.desc: Use skinrestorer to give fake players the summoner’s or a specified player’s skin. Changes are session-only and do not affect real players.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinSet.name: Fake Player Uniform Skin
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSkinSet.desc: When fakePlayerSkinMode is same_skin, the player name whose skin is used for fake players
carpet.rule.fixXaeroLib.name: XaeroLib Compatibility Patch
carpet.rule.fixXaeroLib.desc: Fix fake player data loss issue with newer Xaero versions when used with LuckPerms
carpet.rule.fixBlueMap.name: BlueMap Compatibility Patch
carpet.rule.fixBlueMap.desc: Fix fake players not triggering Fabric API connection events, causing mods like BlueMap to fail tracking fake player join/leave
carpet.rule.invisibleInTallGrass.name: Invisible in Tall Grass
carpet.rule.invisibleInTallGrass.desc: Players become invisible when their head is in tall grass
carpet.rule.playerHat.name: Player Hat
carpet.rule.playerHat.desc: Allow players to wear items on their head, adds /hat command. Totem of Undying on head can trigger death protection
carpet.rule.playerHeadSkin.name: Player Head Skin
carpet.rule.playerHeadSkin.desc: Real and fake players use a worn player head's full skin; removing it or disabling the rule restores their original skin
carpet.rule.ridingPlayers.name: Riding Players
carpet.rule.ridingPlayers.desc: While holding a Totem of Undying, right-click a player's head to ride on top of them (torso does nothing; fake players excluded)
carpet.rule.pickupPlayers.name: Pickup Players
carpet.rule.pickupPlayers.desc: While holding a Totem of Undying, right-click a player's legs to pick them up onto your head (torso does nothing; fake players excluded)
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersStackLimit.name: Riding & Picking Max Limit
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersStackLimit.desc: Maximum number of players that can be stacked when riding or picking up (shared limit)
carpet.rule.ridingPlayersAutoDismount.de: When the player's game mode changes, dismount passengers on head
Client-side required: allows interacting with blocks/entities while having passengers on head
carpet.rule.sleepingDuringTheDay.name: Daydream
carpet.rule.sleepingDuringTheDay.desc: Allow players to sleep during the day, switches to night after sleeping (referenced from PCA)
carpet.rule.unicodeArgumentsSupport.name: Unicode Argument Support
carpet.rule.unicodeArgumentsSupport.desc: Allow non-ASCII characters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.) in command arguments, can be used to summon fake players with Chinese names (ported from YACA)
carpet.rule.betterSnowball.name: Better Snowball
carpet.rule.betterSnowball.desc: Stone hidden in snow. Allows snowballs to deal knockback and damage to players
carpet.rule.fakePlayerDropAll.name: Fake Player Continuous Drop
carpet.rule.fakePlayerDropAll.desc: Add /player dropall to empty a fake player’s inventory immediately or drop its contents one stack at a time at a chosen pace.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSendto.name: Fake Player Inventory Link
carpet.rule.fakePlayerSendto.desc: Add /player sendto to transfer inventory items between fake players at a chosen pace. Links do not survive restarts.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerBrain.name: Fake Player Brain
carpet.rule.fakePlayerBrain.desc: Add /player brain to let fake players act using vanilla mob behavior.
carpet.rule.playerScale.name: Player Scale
carpet.rule.playerScale.desc: Adjust player size with /scale within playerScaleMin and playerScaleMax. FOV compensation requires client installation.
carpet.rule.playerScaleMin.name: Player Scale Min
carpet.rule.playerScaleMin.desc: Minimum scale value all players can set via /scale set; admins can adjust the bound by changing this rule
carpet.rule.playerScaleMax.name: Player Scale Max
carpet.rule.playerScaleMax.desc: Maximum scale value all players can set via /scale set; admins can adjust the bound by changing this rule
carpet.rule.playerScalePhysics.name: Realistic Player Scale
carpet.rule.playerScalePhysics.desc: Scale movement, jumping, reach and gravity with player size, with optional minimum values for small players.
carpet.rule.playerScaleLinkedEntities.de: Living entities spawned by a player using an item inherit that player’s size at spawn. Dispensers, spawners and non-living entities are unaffected.
carpet.rule.peacefulPlayers.name: Peaceful Players
carpet.rule.peacefulPlayers.desc: Toggle PVP per player with /pvp. Disabled players cannot damage or be damaged by other players; settings survive restarts.
carpet.rule.moreEndCrystalTypes.name: More End Crystal Types
carpet.rule.moreEndCrystalTypes.desc: Allow end crystals, including invulnerable ones, on crying obsidian. Placement on obsidian and bedrock is unaffected.
carpet.rule.fixEndCrystalSync.name: Fix End Crystal Sync
carpet.rule.fixEndCrystalSync.desc: Fix client-side position desync when end crystals are pushed by pistons.
carpet.rule.fixStandingOnAir.name: Fix Standing On Air
carpet.rule.fixStandingOnAir.desc: Fixes incorrect support-block resends and suppresses the standing-on-air INFO log. Only affects 26.3.
carpet.rule.patPatPlayers.name: Pat Pat Players
carpet.rule.patPatPlayers.desc: Right-click another real player’s head to pat them, with hearts, a soft sound and a brief crouch. Works with any item and preserves vanilla interactions.
carpet.rule.whoCalledMe.name: Who Called Me
carpet.rule.whoCalledMe.desc: Notify players by sound and title when named in chat, and highlight their names. Can be limited to @mentions.

carpet.rule.textAnimation.name: MiSide Subtitles
carpet.rule.textAnimation.desc: Use /text to play MiSide-style subtitles in front of selected players, typing in before dropping and fading out. Works on vanilla clients.
carpetprimaryuan.command.text.busy: Too many subtitles playing at once (max %s), try again later
carpet.rule.clickThrough.name: Click Through
carpet.rule.clickThrough.desc: Right-clicking a wall sign, wall hanging sign, wall banner, item frame or painting opens the container mounted directly behind it; sneaking keeps the vanilla interaction, so does having no container behind
carpetprimaryuan.command.text.no_player: No online players can receive subtitles right now
carpetprimaryuan.command.text.need_targe: §cTarget required: @a (everyone) or an online player name, e.g. /text @a hello
carpet.rule.countdown.name: Timer
carpet.rule.countdown.desc: Run a count-up or countdown with /timer, choosing display position (bar/center/actionbar/both) and effect tier (simple/normal/fancy), with pause, resume and live adjustments; legacy /countdown syntax stays as a compatibility entry.

carpet.rule.whoCalledMeHighlight.desc: highlight color of the mentioned player's name in chat and title; false=no highlight
carpet.rule.serverTransfer.name: Server Transfer
carpet.rule.serverTransfer.desc: Adds /tpto and /tptoset: players click a server in the list to transfer themselves to another server.
